content: Xomppeta Gishshas Naageteth
GODAY Muses hizgides,
«Dunkaanezan pacey baynda poo7ana mala ooththanaas wogara miththafe gum7i xillisi kessida zayte Isra7eele dere asay nees ehana mala azaza.

Aarooney omars omars xomppeza oyseththo; hessika Gaytoteththa Dunkaaneza giddon diza Caaqo Qaala Taabotazappe sinththa baggara diza magalashaappe kare baggara GODAA sinththan gadey wonttana gakkanaas poo7ishe aqo; hayssi ha wogazi sinththafe yaana yeletaas mernaa woga gido.
Aarooney he xomppeta woththiza walakay baynda worqqafe oosettida ballaza bolla diza xomppeti pacey baynda GODAA sinththan poo7ana mala naago.
Xoossas Shiiqiza Kaththa Yarsho
«Tammanne nam7u kilo gidiza liiqo dhiille ekkada tammanne nam7u uketh uukka.
Ukeththatappe usuppunata bollara walakay baynda worqqan tiyettida xaraphpheeza bolla issi baggara woththa; qasse hankko usuppunata hankko baggara diza maaddaa bolla maaran maaran woththa.
GODAAS taman xuugetti yarshettiza kaththa yarsho gididayssa qofsanaas muuruta exaane nam7u baggarakka woththa.
Hayssa ha ukeththaza Sambatan Sambatan ubba wode Aarooney GODAA sinththan Isra7eele asaa gishshas woththo; hayssi Isra7eele asay pacey baynda ooththana mala bessiza caaqo qaala.

Ukeththay Aaroonessinne iza zereththatas gisha gido; istti ukeththaa GODAAS dummatidason metto; hessika GODAAS taman xuugetti shiiqiza yarshotappe keehi dummatida Aaroonessinne iza zereththatas imettida gisha gido.»
Qoho Gaason Gakkiza Qixaate
Aayi baggara Isra7eele, aawa baggara Gibxe dere as gidida issaadey dees; izikka issi gallas ba diza heeran diza issi Isra7eele as gididaarira ooyettides.
He aayey baggara Isra7eele as gididayssi ooyettishe GODAA sunth cayides; histtiin izaade Musekko ehida; he addeza aaya Daane baggafe gidida Dibraye naa Shalomito geetettawus.
Istti iza bolla ay qixaate yegganaas bessizaakko GODAY isttas yootana gakkanaas iza qasho keeththan yeggida.
GODAY Muses hizgides,

«He addeza asay dizasoppe gede haraso kessa; izi Xoossa cayishin siyida ubbay hessaadey mooro ooththidayssa markkattanaas issoy issoy ba kushe he addeza hu7e bolla woththo; hessafe kaallidi kumeththa Isra7eele derey iza shuchchan caddi wodho.
Tana Xoossaa cayida ay asikka hessaththoka ba qixaate ekko.
GODAA cayida ay as gidiinkka derey ubbay iza shuchchan caddi wodho; Isra7eele as gidiin woykko Isra7eele dere garsan diza hara dere as gidiin GODAA cayidaadey shuchchan cadetti hayqqo.
«Ase wodhidaadey oonikka hayqon qaxxayetto.
Asa mehe wodhidaadey iza mala mehe qanxxo; hessi he waagazi shemppo gishshas shemppo qanxxiza woga.
«Ay asikka hara asa bolla qoho gaththiko izaadey qoho gaththidayssa mala qohoy he gaththidaade bolla gakko.
Meqeth menththidaades meqeththi meqqo; ayfe toyssidaades ayfey to7o; ach menththidaades achchi meqqo; hara asa bolla ay qohokka gaththidaades izi gaththida qohoza malay iza bolla gakko.
Mehe wodhidaadey mehe qanxxo; ase wodhidaadey gidikko hayqon qaxxayetto.
Hayssi wogazi inttes Isra7eele naytas gidiin woykko intte giddon diza hara dere asaa ubbaassa; gaasoykka tani GODAA intte Xoossaa.»
Musey hessa ubbaa derezas yooti polidaappe guye he Xoossaa cayida addeza asi dizasoppe haraso kessidi shuchchara caddi wodhida; hessaththoka Isra7eele asay GODAY Muse azazida mala ooththida.
